title: Front Entry (1F)
summary: The sunken terrazzo entryway on the ground floor. A bench of reclaimed camphor wood sits beneath geometric 1970s iron window grilles.
inspect_text: Polished grey concrete steps drop down from the front door into the entryway. Reclaimed camphor wood forms a low bench where street shoes are exchanged for leather indoor slippers. Geometric 1970s iron grilles frame frosted begonia glass, casting patterned shadows across the floor. The open kitchen and living room extend just beyond the threshold.

features.label: camphor shoe bench
features.inspect_text: A thick, fragrant slab of camphor wood. Beneath it sit rows of neatly lined shoes: work clogs, worn sneakers, platform boots, and leather mules.

features.label: leather slippers
features.inspect_text: A wooden rack holding simple tan leather slippers for moving silently across the villa's terrazzo and wooden floors.

features.label: iron window grilles
features.inspect_text: Historic Taiwanese security grilles twisted into geometric floral motifs, holding panes of frosted begonia glass that blur the alleyway outside.

title: Open Kitchen (1F)
summary: A central stainless-steel island on the ground floor with commercial gas burners, overhead copper racks, and deep sinks. The culinary heart of the house.
inspect_text: Professional stainless steel dominates the space, balanced by warm teak cabinets and matte black fixtures. A commercial four-burner gas range sits beneath an industrial range hood. Beside the prep sink rests a neat wooden pour-over coffee station, a glass-door beverage fridge, and Ren's canvas knife roll, laid out with clinical precision.

features.label: stainless-steel island
features.inspect_text: A massive brushed stainless-steel prep island with commercial gas burners and an end-grain wooden chopping block. It's built for two people to cook side-by-side—or bump shoulders uncomfortably.

features.label: pour-over coffee station
features.inspect_text: A brass Hario dripper, a goose-neck kettle with digital temperature readout, and a matte black conical burr grinder. A glass jar holds fresh medium-roast beans from a boutique roaster in Zhongshan.

features.label: glass-door refrigerator
features.inspect_text: A commercial glass-front refrigerator stocked with cold oat milk, bottles of Taiwanese sparkling mineral water, fresh Yilan mountain greens, tofu cakes, and several bottles of natural orange wine.

title: Dining Room (1F)
summary: A solid Taiwanese cypress ten-seater table on the ground floor under low ceramic pendant lamps. Where group meals and quiet standoffs occur.
inspect_text: The ten-foot dining table is cut from a single reclaimed slab of Taiwanese cypress (hinoki), smooth and faintly fragrant. Ten wishbone chairs surround it. Three fluted ceramic pendant lamps hang low over the surface, casting a warm 2400K pool of light that makes every glance and hesitation across the table impossible to hide.

features.label: cypress dining table
features.inspect_text: The long cypress table bears the natural grain of mountain timber. It is large enough for all six housemates to dine together, yet intimate enough that foot-touches and subtle eye-rolls are instantly noticed.

features.label: fluted pendant lamps
features.inspect_text: Low-slung handmade ceramic lamp shades in matte terracotta, casting pools of warm golden light over the table while leaving the surrounding room in soft shadow.

title: Sunken Living Lounge (1F)
summary: Sunken into emerald-flecked terrazzo. Low modular sofa, art monographs, floating teak stairs up to 2F, and an acoustic soundproof door down to B1.
inspect_text: Three shallow concrete steps descend into a sunken floor of polished emerald-and-white flecked terrazzo (mo-shi-zi), delightfully cool beneath bare feet. A deep, modular slate-grey linen sofa wraps around two sides of the space. There is deliberately no television; low teak bookshelves hold art monographs and photography collections, and floor-to-ceiling iron glass doors open out into the verdant courtyard. Along the exposed concrete wall, a cantilevered staircase of floating teak steps leads up to the 2F design studio, while a heavy acoustic door conceals the stairs down to the B1 diary room.

features.label: low modular sofa
features.inspect_text: A low-slung, ultra-deep sofa upholstered in textured slate linen. Floor cushions allow three or four people to lounge in close proximity without having to sit upright.

features.label: travertine coffee table
features.inspect_text: A low slab of porous cream travertine. At any given hour, it holds half-empty mugs of roasted barley tea, sketchbooks, and discarded reading glasses.

features.label: art monograph bookshelf
features.inspect_text: Built-in teak shelves filled with Japanese architectural volumes, Korean indie film retrospectives, and vintage Taipei street photography books.

features.label: cantilevered teak stairs up to 2F
features.inspect_text: Open floating teak steps anchored into board-formed concrete, climbing along the wall up to the second-floor design studio.

features.label: courtyard accordion doors
features.inspect_text: Floor-to-ceiling iron-framed glass accordion doors connecting the lounge and the interior courtyard.

descriptions.inspect_text: The black iron-framed accordion doors are folded flat against the wall, seamlessly joining the sunken lounge with the verdant courtyard.
The floor-to-ceiling glass accordion doors are closed shut, keeping the summer heat and humidity in the courtyard while maintaining a clear view of the banyan tree.

interactions.label: Fold the accordion doors shut
lines: You pull the heavy iron accordion doors across the brass track until the rubber weatherstripping seals tight.

interactions.label: Fold the accordion doors open
lines: You unlock the central latch and fold the glass panels accordion-style back against the wall, opening the lounge to the courtyard breeze.

features.label: acoustic soundproof door
features.inspect_text: A heavy acoustic soundproof door leading down to the basement diary room.

descriptions.inspect_text: The heavy acoustic door to the basement diary room stands ajar. The 'ON AIR' indicator above the frame is unlit.
The heavy acoustic door to the basement diary room is sealed shut. The amber 'ON AIR' indicator glows softly above the frame.

interactions.label: Close the soundproof door
lines: You pull the heavy acoustic door shut until the magnetic latch seals with a muffled thud.

interactions.label: Open the soundproof door
lines: You turn the brushed metal lever handle and push the heavy acoustic door open.

title: Interior Courtyard (1F)
summary: An open-air ground-floor atrium framed by raw board-formed concrete. A fifty-year-old banyan tree and wild elephant-ear leaves catch the afternoon rain.
inspect_text: Natural daylight pours down three stories into this raw concrete courtyard. A mature banyan tree's aerial roots twist into a bed of smooth river stones, surrounded by giant elephant-ear leaves (guanyin-lian) and wild ferns. When summer thunderstorms break over Taipei, rain cascades down the concrete walls into a recessed gravel drain.

features.label: fifty-year banyan tree
features.inspect_text: A majestic banyan tree whose aerial roots drape down toward the river stones, its dense canopy filtering the intense subtropical sunlight into dancing dappled shadows.

features.label: carved stone bench
features.inspect_text: A smooth bench hewn from grey Guanyin stone. The stone stays cool even during the heat of mid-afternoon, making it an ideal retreat for solitary phone calls or quiet conversations.

features.label: giant elephant-ear plants
features.inspect_text: Lush tropical elephant-ear leaves the size of dinner trays. Droplets of rain or condensation glisten on their waxy green surfaces.

features.label: courtyard accordion doors
features.inspect_text: Floor-to-ceiling iron-framed glass accordion doors connecting the lounge and the interior courtyard.

descriptions.inspect_text: The iron accordion doors are folded open flat against the wall, joining the atrium with the sunken lounge.
The glass accordion doors are folded shut, reflecting the banyan tree and keeping the living room cooled.

interactions.label: Fold the accordion doors shut
lines: You pull the iron accordion doors shut, sealing the courtyard from the lounge.

interactions.label: Fold the accordion doors open
lines: You release the latch and fold the accordion doors back, connecting the courtyard to the lounge.

title: Design Studio & Library (2F)
summary: A glass-walled creative workspace on the second floor overlooking the courtyard. Flanked by editing bays, drafting tables, an open stairwell down to 1F, and a spiral staircase to 3F.
inspect_text: Large iron-frame windows overlook the courtyard below. A long birch workbench holds Aera's twin calibrated color reference monitors and editing control surface. Across the room sits Yuhan's tilted drafting table covered with tracing paper blueprints, and on a low credenza, a vintage Marantz turntable spins vinyl records at low volume. An open stairwell leads down to the 1F living lounge, a sliding door opens into the girls' dormitory, and a black spiral staircase corkscrews up to the 3F rooftop terrace.

features.label: video editing station
features.inspect_text: Two 4K calibrated color grading displays, a pair of studio monitor speakers, and a jog-shuttle editing wheel. A pair of closed-back studio headphones rests on a cork block.

features.label: architectural drafting table
features.inspect_text: An adjustable wooden drafting board clamped with brass parallel bars. Rolls of butter paper and heavy blueprint tubes lean in a canvas basket.

features.label: vintage vinyl turntable
features.inspect_text: A warm walnut-cased turntable hooked up to a tube amplifier. Stacks of vinyl records include Taiwanese indie dream-pop, Japanese city pop, and quiet piano solos.

features.label: open stairwell down to 1F
features.inspect_text: A wide wooden opening with a minimalist steel railing, looking down into the sunken emerald terrazzo of the living lounge on the ground floor.

features.label: black spiral stairs up to 3F
features.inspect_text: A matte-black steel spiral staircase corkscrewing through an open ceiling lightwell up to the rooftop terrace.

features.label: frosted begonia sliding door
features.inspect_text: A dark-stained cypress sliding door with frosted begonia glass panes leading to the girls' dormitory.

descriptions.inspect_text: The dark-stained cypress sliding door is slid open against the wall, leaving the doorway into the girls' dormitory wide open.
The cypress sliding door is drawn shut. Vintage frosted begonia glass diffuses the warm interior lights of the girls' room.

interactions.label: Slide the bedroom door shut
lines: You slide the cypress door smoothly along its wooden track until it gently clicks closed.

interactions.label: Slide the bedroom door open
lines: You slide the begonia glass door back along its recessed track, opening the entrance.

title: Girls' Dormitory (2F)
summary: The second-floor dormitory with an elevated tatami platform holding three low linen futons, partitioned from the studio by begonia-embossed sliding glass.
inspect_text: Fragrant rush tatami mats cover the elevated sleeping platform of this second-floor sanctuary, where three low linen futons are neatly made. Soft sliding partitions with begonia-embossed glass diffuse the morning light and open back into the design studio. A tall industrial steel clothing rack holds a striking cross-section of wardrobes: Aera's oversized Korean tailoring, Mio's avant-garde streetwear, and Yuhan's structured black linens.

features.label: tatami futon beds
features.inspect_text: Three minimalist floor futons dressed in crisp washed linen duvets in charcoal, unbleached flax, and pale sage. Small bedside reading lamps sit on lacquered trays.

features.label: industrial clothing rack
features.inspect_text: Heavy steel pipe rack hung with designer trench coats, vintage leather jackets, and pleated trousers. The top shelf holds hat boxes and camera cases.

features.label: shared vanity mirror
features.inspect_text: A broad vanity mirror framed by soft LED globes. The wooden surface below is crowded with expensive skincare serums, lip tints, and bottles of boutique fragrance.

features.label: frosted begonia sliding door
features.inspect_text: A dark-stained cypress sliding door with frosted begonia glass panes leading to the girls' dormitory.

descriptions.inspect_text: The dark-stained cypress sliding door is pushed back, revealing the sunlit design studio outside.
The cypress sliding door is closed tight, ensuring total privacy inside the dormitory.

interactions.label: Slide the bedroom door open
lines: You slide the begonia glass door open, looking out into the studio.

interactions.label: Slide the bedroom door shut
lines: You pull the sliding door shut from inside, isolating the room.

title: Rooftop Terrace (3F)
summary: Weathered teak decking on the third floor under a corrugated glass awning, with humming laundry machines, festoon fairy lights, spiral stairs down to 2F, and views of Taipei 101.
inspect_text: Warm teak boards stretch across the third-floor terrace beneath a high corrugated glass roof that shelters the space from afternoon cloudbursts. Twin washing machines hum softly in the laundry corner, surrounded by drying racks of clothes catching the warm evening draft. Festoon lights string between steel posts, illuminating a comfortable outdoor daybed. In the corner, a matte-black spiral staircase descends to the 2F studio, while a fluted glass door opens into the guys' dormitory. Across the terracotta rooftops of Da'an, the spire of Taipei 101 glimmers in the night haze.

features.label: teak outdoor daybed
features.inspect_text: A deep outdoor daybed with weather-resistant charcoal cushions and throw pillows. It smells faintly of cedar and evening rain—a favorite spot for midnight beers.

features.label: laundry machines
features.inspect_text: Two commercial front-loading washers and dryers humming through rinse cycles. A bottle of eucalyptus laundry detergent sits on the dryer.

features.label: festoon string lights
features.inspect_text: Heavy outdoor string lights with vintage amber Edison bulbs, bathing the rooftop in a soft, nostalgic glow after sunset.

features.label: Taipei 101 skyline
features.inspect_text: Between the rusty metal fire escapes and water tanks of neighboring townhouses, the illuminated tiers of Taipei 101 rise into the subtropical clouds.

features.label: spiral stairs down to 2F
features.inspect_text: The top of the matte-black spiral staircase, sheltered beneath the corrugated glass awning, leading down into the second-floor design studio.

features.label: fluted glass terrace door
features.inspect_text: A fluted glass terrace door connecting the rooftop terrace to the guys' dormitory.

descriptions.inspect_text: The terrace door stands propped open, letting the evening rooftop air drift into the bedroom.
The terrace door is shut firmly against the mountain wind, its fluted glass panes rattling faintly in the frame.

interactions.label: Shut the terrace door
lines: You pull the terrace door shut against the weatherstripping until the latch catches.

interactions.label: Open the terrace door
lines: You turn the brass latch and push the terrace door open to the rooftop breezes.

title: Guys' Dormitory (3F)
summary: The third-floor guys' dormitory with polished terrazzo, three industrial steel-frame beds, Daichi's road bike on a wall mount, and a terrace door to 3F rooftop.
inspect_text: Airy, clean, and masculine in an unstudied way, occupying the top floor alongside the terrace. Polished grey terrazzo holds three black powder-coated steel beds with charcoal linen duvets. On the far brick wall, Daichi's matte-black carbon road bike hangs from precision aluminum brackets above a foam roller. In the corner sits Kai's vintage tweed guitar amplifier and guitar gig bags, beside Ren's neatly stacked Japanese culinary magazines. A fluted glass door opens directly onto the 3F rooftop terrace.

features.label: steel-frame beds
features.inspect_text: Three black steel beds: Daichi's bed is made with military precision; Kai's bed has a tangled duvet and loose guitar picks; Ren's bed is flanked by a stack of culinary notebooks.

features.label: carbon road bike wall mount
features.inspect_text: An ultra-light aerodynamic racing bicycle with deep-section carbon wheels, spotless chain, and a GPS computer mount on the cockpit.

features.label: vintage guitar amp and cases
features.inspect_text: A 1970s Fender tweed combo amplifier, a beaten-up hard shell guitar case plastered with indie band stickers, and a coiled cloth instrument cable.

features.label: fluted glass terrace door
features.inspect_text: A fluted glass terrace door connecting the rooftop terrace to the guys' dormitory.

descriptions.inspect_text: The fluted glass terrace door stands propped open to the rooftop terrace.
The terrace door is pulled shut from within the bedroom, filtering the city lights outside into vertical fluted stripes.

interactions.label: Open the terrace door
lines: You unlatch the terrace door and push it open to the night air.

interactions.label: Shut the terrace door
lines: You pull the fluted glass door shut, quieting the rooftop draft.

title: Diary Room (B1)
summary: A soundproof subterranean booth in the basement with a single wooden stool facing a two-way mirror and concrete steps leading back up to 1F.
inspect_text: Completely isolated in the basement beneath the house. Sound-dampening acoustic charcoal panels line the walls, absorbing every stray frequency. A single polished wooden stool sits beneath a soft overhead key light. In front of the stool is a dark two-way mirror, behind which a hidden studio camera and teleprompter record every blink, swallow, and hesitation. Behind the stool, a heavy acoustic door opens to concrete steps leading back up to the 1F living lounge.

features.label: wooden interview stool
features.inspect_text: A backless oak stool bolted to the floor in the center of the key light. Anyone sitting here has nowhere to hide their body language.

features.label: two-way glass mirror
features.inspect_text: A dark pane of one-way glass. To the contestant, it reflects only their own isolated face; to the production team behind it, the camera lens is staring straight into their eyes.

features.label: overhead boom microphone
features.inspect_text: A hyper-cardioid shotgun microphone suspended from the acoustic ceiling, sensitive enough to capture whispered confessions and sharp intakes of breath.

features.label: acoustic soundproof door to 1F
features.inspect_text: A heavy acoustic soundproof door leading up the concrete steps to the 1F living lounge.

descriptions.inspect_text: The heavy acoustic door to the lounge upstairs stands ajar, revealing the emerald terrazzo floor above.
The heavy acoustic door is sealed shut from the inside, completely insulating this space from the rest of the house.

interactions.label: Open the soundproof door
lines: You press the release latch and push the soundproof door open, revealing the light from the lounge above.

interactions.label: Close the soundproof door
lines: You pull the door firmly shut, sealing yourself in total silence.
